ns2:course.label: Fictions of Equality
ns2:course.description: Fictions of Equality is a multi-section Grand Challenge Learning pilot course in the Inequality & Cultural Understanding pathway. Each section engages specific dimensions of Inequality & Cultural understanding from an interdisciplinary perspective while meeting the Gen Ed criteria for Humanities & the Arts (Literature and the Arts). Each section emphasizes experiential learning through, for example, projects, community engaged scholarship, field trips, archival work, or experimental writing. Prerequisite: Restricted to first-time new freshman or first-year transfer students.
